title: ACHAL risk grid v1
description: Published by the risk engine on achal/{site}/risk/grid (retained) every evaluation tick. Interpolated fused risk over the site, for the dashboard heatmap.

x0_m.description: Local x (east, metres from the panel's south-west corner) of column 0

y0_m.description: Local y (north) of row 0, the southmost row

values.description: Row-major, rows x cols, row 0 = southmost
